methodology.calendar_windows: Metrics labelled 1Y use observations occurring within the trailing one calendar year. Metrics labelled 3Y use observations occurring within the trailing three calendar years. Observation-count proxies such as 252/756 are not used.
methodology.spread_history: Each spread uses dates on which both constituent raw series have observations. Statistical spread series are not forward-filled.
methodology.cp_composite: Mean trailing-one-calendar-year standardized A2/P2 minus AA nonfinancial CP spread across 30D, 60D and 90D maturities. At least two maturities are required.
methodology.monitor_alignment: The synchronized CP monitoring layer permits a maximum five-business-day forward fill. This alignment is not used when estimating raw-series AR(1), z-score, percentile or ADF statistics.
methodology.half_life: AR(1)-implied mean-reversion half-life = -ln(2)/ln(phi), reported in observations and only where 0 < phi < 1.
methodology.adf: Augmented Dickey-Fuller test with constant and AIC lag selection on the full raw spread history.
